targets.review_note: Parse the actual2D textual grammar: leftmost occupied column identifies the expression baseline; a fraction bar is at least3 consecutivehyphens and spans numerator/denominator; a separated singlehyphen is unary/binary subtraction. Recursive rectangles isolate parentheses and fractions, while an exponent is the digit immediately above/right of a primary. Standard multiplication/addition precedence applies; denominator inversion is modulo2011. All spatial syntax needed is represented in BNF, detailed text, and12 complete ASCII examples; illustrative image is unnecessary. The prose example says -4/3 while its displayed rows show -3/4; follow the explicit glyph grammar and published input/output (-3/4=502). Verify independently generated AST renderings and arithmetic, not hidden cases.
